title: Retain operational failure causes in credit-admission diagnostics
outcome: Preserve bounded internal diagnostic context for credit-admission persistence, fence, transport and request-decoding refusals, correlated with the exact run, while retaining typed public refusal contracts.
acceptance: Operational refusal diagnostics identify the run and distinguish underlying persistence/fence/transport or decoding causes without exposing sensitive bodies or changing typed API refusal semantics.

Focused deterministic controls verify diagnostic correlation for representative causes, including a failed persist candidate followed by unchanged retry, without granting credit or an early acknowledgement.
